data.title: 早露 · 桌上的白花
data.description: 白花刚插进瓶里，枝条便朝一边散开。早露旋转花瓶，找到一个大家都能看见的位置。
data.promptProse: Inside a bright, airy workshop, Rosa delicately arranges a variety of fresh winter flowers—white lilies, holly, and blue-tinted seasonal blooms—into a crystalline glass vase. Sunbeams stream through a large window, creating sparkling refractions on the vase, while scattered green stems, floral shears, and ribbons litter the wooden workbench, bathed in crisp, clean morning light.
data.animaCaption: Standing at the wooden flower workshop bench, she gently sets fresh white lilies and winter blooms into a clear glass vase with calm artistic focus. Crisp morning sunbeams refract brightly through the vase onto shears and ribbons.
